assumptions: Shape (1), artifact from main, was chosen over (2), measuring the base in-job, because (2) roughly doubles the guardian test time against the duration ratchet (#760/#820).
The existing TS engine (pilot) job already runs vitest with the lcov reporter on every push to main, so a push-only upload step there adds no new job or check context.
A base artifact counts only if its producing run's head_sha equals the PR's merge-base SHA and its head_branch equals the PR base. Otherwise the result is head-only and is never substituted.
Fork PRs, expired artifacts (after 30 days) and merge bases from before this change degrade to the existing head-only notice with exit 0.
